summary: Repository-only, DARK/default-OFF wiring (ADR-0085) of the ADR-0084 PURE lifecycle guard into the bridge's three real follower-mutation paths, plus the persistence->operator-alert mapping onto the EXISTING canonical records. Gated by COPIER_LIFECYCLE_GUARD_ENABLED (default OFF). NO migration. The three money functions (close_position / modify_position / partial_close_position) are byte-for-byte UNCHANGED and keep their demo wall, so the guard enables no live mutation and opens no new order path. No production change, no host contact, no broker order, no credential handled, no flag armed.
phase1_bridge_path_identification: Identified the exact production bridge and the three mutation paths before editing: HTTP POST /mt5/close-position -> close_position; POST /mt5/modify-position -> modify_position; the dedicated DEMO partial-close worker (mt5_partial_close_worker) -> partial_close_position (authorize-send/claim/complete). The poll path (process_job) handles PLACE_ORDER only (validate_job_safety rejects non-PLACE_ORDER) and is NOT touched. The guard API (admit_mutation / classify_result) and the backend _live_command_envelope match the ADR-0084/0083 assumptions (verified, no material divergence -> no STOP).

delivery_state: PR_READY — repository-only, DARK/default-OFF, auto-merge OFF, STOP before merge. The live money path is byte-identical when the flag is OFF; the money functions are unchanged. This packet does NOT enable live mutation (the demo wall stays) and does NOT deploy, contact the host, apply a migration, arm a flag, create a live authorization, or place/modify/close any order.
feature_flag_and_gate_proof: COPIER_LIFECYCLE_GUARD_ENABLED (default OFF) on the host bridge (guard_enabled / _copier_guard_active); backend copier_lifecycle_guard_enabled() (default OFF, ANDed with the master gate) gates the authorize_send command emission only. _copier_guard_active checks `if not command` first then the env flag (only 1/true/yes/on enable; a malformed value never enables). The guard is ANDed with a typed command; with the flag OFF or no command the wrapper calls the UNCHANGED money function and returns its result verbatim (proven byte-identical by the flag-off / malformed-flag / no-command tests). It never ORs past, and never widens, the execute/arm/demo-live gates.
pre_state_and_deadline_design: Immediately before a mutation, _guard_follower_snapshot reads the follower position (login/server from account_info, symbol/volume/sl/tp from positions_get, point/volume_step from symbol_info) under the same guarded_initialize attach as every other MT5 touch; a read failure is NEVER treated as absence (ok=False -> fail closed, send nothing). admit_mutation then verifies: operation in {MODIFY_PROTECTION,PARTIAL_CLOSE,FULL_CLOSE}; hard deadline (now>=authorization_expires_at -> DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, missing -> CONTAINED); monotonic revision (command.master_revision <= command.last_applied_revision -> STALE_REVISION); position presence (absent -> POSITION_NOT_FOUND for modify/partial, idempotent ALREADY_APPLIED for full); MANDATORY identity+symbol fingerprint (require_identity_pin + login + server + symbol all required and matched, else CONTAINED / PRE_STATE_MISMATCH); partial strictly-reducing. A missing/ambiguous/stale/mismatched/past-deadline pre-state refuses the send.
mutation_semantics: MODIFY (add/change/remove SL/TP): admit requires a numeric target (never strips protection), idempotent ALREADY_APPLIED when the follower already carries the requested SL/TP; classify re-verifies the post-state; a broker stop/freeze rejection stays truthful (the money function's existing retcode handling is unchanged). FULL CLOSE: idempotent (absent -> ALREADY_APPLIED); classify APPLIED only when the post-snapshot confirms the position is gone; a confirmed-gone lost-ACK close reconciles a stale residual_exposure marker to a self-consistent success; a still-open close is CONTAINED (ok forced False). PARTIAL CLOSE: strictly-reducing against the fresh follower volume, idempotent at expected_remaining, over-close/step/min enforced by the UNCHANGED money function; classify APPLIED only when the post volume equals expected_remaining, position-gone-after-partial -> CONTAINED (never 'applied'), never a full close unless intended remaining is genuinely zero.
outcome_to_persistence_to_alert_wiring: Bridge result carries lifecycle_outcome/lifecycle_reason. record_lifecycle_outcome(replication, bridge_result, op) maps a terminal outcome to the EXISTING ADR-0083 failure categories (PRE_STATE_MISMATCH/DEADLINE_EXCEEDED/UNKNOWN_OUTCOME/CONTAINED_FAILURE, and op-specific MODIFICATION_FAILED/FULL_CLOSE_FAILED/PARTIAL_CLOSE_FAILED for BROKER_REJECTED), writes CopierReplication.reconciliation_status NON-DESTRUCTIVELY (only over empty or a prior guard outcome — never a reconciler-owned MATCHED/UNMATCHED/AMBIGUOUS/DIVERGENT_MISSING/PCLOSE_* status), and raises ONE de-duplicated governed reliability.AlertEvent (gated by copier_alerts_enabled, fail-open, secret-free, ticket redacted). Success raises no alert; UNKNOWN_OUTCOME alerts (never inferred as success). The read-only ADR-0083 operator view surfaces it. Partial-close path end-to-end: authorize_send emits the server-derived command -> worker threads it -> a guard block is recorded by the existing consumer as a pre-send dispatch-refusal (guard_blocked) so 'nothing sent' stays true. The close/modify armed dispatcher that POSTs the envelope and feeds record_lifecycle_outcome is the (separately gated) next step.
no_late_recovery_proof: The guard never opens a position (only MODIFY/PARTIAL/FULL on an existing LINKED follower ticket). A past-deadline mutation is DEADLINE_EXCEEDED; a missing position is POSITION_NOT_FOUND (modify/partial) or idempotent ALREADY_APPLIED (full) — never a replacement market entry. The only retries anywhere are the money function's bounded read / verification reads that cannot create/modify/close a position; a reconciliation (partial-close) is a read, not a re-dispatch. No new order placement path becomes reachable through the guard: on PROCEED it calls exactly the money function the un-guarded path calls (proven by test_proceed_calls_exactly_the_money_function_no_new_path).
no_widening_proof: The money functions are byte-for-byte unchanged and keep their demo wall (trade_mode!=0 -> account_not_demo) and identity gate; CLOSE/MODIFY/PARTIAL-CLOSE remain demo-only and independently fail-closed for LIVE. The guard only REJECTS a send every gate already permits, or CLASSIFIES the outcome; it authorises nothing and reaches no PLACE_ORDER/open path. Enabling LIVE mutation is a separate Sponsor gate (ADR-0085 Remaining work), NOT this packet.
migration_status: NONE. makemigrations --check: No changes detected. No model field was added (the two new reconciliation_status values are plain strings in a free CharField; CopierLiveAuthorization fields already exist from ADR-0083 migration 0012).
limitations: Repository-only, DARK, default-OFF. No merge, no deploy, no migration applied, no host contact, no flag armed, no live authorization, no broker order, no credential handled.

Production truth (prod backend e12a20c9; execution + all copier flags OFF; COPIER_LIFECYCLE_GUARD_ENABLED default OFF; zero queued/running copier execution jobs; zero broker orders) is asserted from the AUTHORITATIVE record (Notion ledger + prior evidence + this repository), NOT by contacting production — this packet forbids host/production contact, and read-only production/DB access is a separate Sponsor gate not granted here.

The close/modify half is bridge-only (no production caller POSTs a copier_operation body to /mt5/close-position or /mt5/modify-position yet, and record_lifecycle_outcome has no production caller) — the gated armed close/modify dispatcher is the next step; the partial-close path is wired end-to-end. This matches the DARK, logic-only-not-yet-armed intent.

last_applied_revision is passed from the command (default -1), NOT from CopierPositionLifecycle.applied_sequence (a master-event projection HWM that would wrongly reject the first legitimate follower mutation). A per-follower-mutation watermark is the documented next step; until then the authoritative ordering is the backend lifecycle projection + the governing-authorization staleness guards.

No live readiness is claimed on synthetic tests. Arming the guard requires MT5_BRIDGE_THREADED on (so MT5 access is serialized) — a documented deployment precondition enforced at the separate arming step.

adversarial_review.method: One independent adversarial subagent lane across the full wiring (bridge wrappers + handlers, worker threading, both backend consumers, the recorder, the three money-function result shapes). Attack checklist: flag bypass / OFF-identity, fail-closed, execution-authority expansion / new order path, stale state / replay / out-of-order, cross-tenant / ticket reuse / forged HTTP body, partial-close arithmetic & double-reduce, transport ambiguity / retry safety, alert truthfulness / secrets, exceptions.
adversarial_review.result: No CRITICAL, no HIGH. Verified safe: OFF/no-command byte-identical (auto-breakeven / WS-E close callers unaffected), fail-closed throughout, no live mutation or new order path (PROCEED calls the same unchanged money function which re-enforces identity/demo), a forged HTTP body cannot reach a wrong-account or live mutation, the partial guard_blocked routing cannot be mis-recorded as sent (no double-reduce).

findings.title: record_lifecycle_outcome non-stomp guard only covered PARTIAL_TERMINAL_STATES, so (with set_reconciliation=True) it could overwrite an in-flight PCLOSE_* or an open-reconciler MATCHED/UNMATCHED/AMBIGUOUS status that other lifecycle ops depend on.
findings.fix: Write reconciliation_status ONLY over an empty status or a prior ADR-0084 guard outcome; never over a reconciler-owned status. Regressions: test_never_stomps_follower_ticket_binding_status, test_never_stomps_in_flight_partial_status, test_writes_over_empty_and_prior_guard_outcome. (Latent: no production caller yet, but a real default-argument footgun.)

findings.title: The guard's post-snapshot had no settle delay, so broker propagation lag could mis-verdict a genuinely-successful FULL_CLOSE as CONTAINED (false ok=False + a potential false-CRITICAL alert + corrupted reconciliation status).
findings.fix: Added a tunable post-send settle (GUVFX_GUARD_POST_SETTLE_SECONDS, default 1.5s) before the authoritative re-read; documented the MT5_BRIDGE_THREADED arming precondition in ADR-0085.

findings.title: A lost-ACK close whose position is confirmed gone returned a contradictory {ok:False, residual_exposure:True, lifecycle_outcome:APPLIED} — a consumer keying on ok vs lifecycle_outcome would disagree.
findings.fix: On a confirmed APPLIED verdict the wrapper reconciles the stale money-side failure marker (ok->True, residual_exposure cleared); it only UPGRADES ok on an authoritative post-state confirmation, never fabricates one. Regression: test_applied_reconciles_stale_residual_exposure.

findings.title: A guarded partial that returns ALREADY_APPLIED (no send) is recorded by the existing consumer as PCLOSE_SENT before the authoritative reconcile.
findings.note: Benign: the authoritative reconcile resolves it to PCLOSE_RECONCILED -> SUCCESS with no double-reduce; the terminal state is correct. The audited consumer state machine is deliberately left unchanged (preserve-behavior).

findings.title: The guard authorises/idempotency-checks against requested_post_state while the money function sends the body/arg values and the backend reconciles payload[expected_remaining].
findings.note: Consistent by construction in _live_command_envelope / create_live_*_job (top-level sl/tp/expected_remaining equal requested_post_state); and classify_result re-verifies the ACTUAL post-state against requested_post_state, so a sent!=authorised divergence surfaces as CONTAINED. Documented as defence-in-depth, not a live defect.

findings.title: Close/modify half is bridge-only (no production caller of record_lifecycle_outcome; nothing POSTs a copier body to /mt5/close-position or /mt5/modify-position).
findings.note: Matches the DARK, logic-only-not-yet-armed intent; the gated armed close/modify dispatcher is the documented next step (ADR-0085).

findings.title: With MT5_BRIDGE_THREADED OFF the serialization lock is a no-op and the guard's extra attach/shutdown cycles enlarge the pre-existing unlocked-concurrent-MT5 window.
findings.note: ADR-0085 records the arming precondition: COPIER_LIFECYCLE_GUARD_ENABLED is armed only on a bridge with MT5_BRIDGE_THREADED on. Enforced at the separate arming step, not in this flag-OFF packet.

reviewer: One independent adversarial subagent lane + author disposition. No CRITICAL/HIGH. 3 MEDIUM fixed with regression tests; 2 LOW accepted with disposition; 2 INFO documented. No order placed, no credential handled, no production mutation, no flag armed, no live authorization.
